summary.headline: Front VIX normalized sharply while October/November call supply stayed active and deferred December protection remained.
key_points: Directional flow excluding the Oct28 financing vertical was about -$78.5M transaction VIX delta.
October 22C, November 20C and November 35C short-call inventories are OI-confirmed and received continuation flow.
October 19C and November 28C correction hedges are also OI-confirmed, so the book retains moderate-stress protection under the short-vol surface.
October 25 changed role: prior selling reduced OI, while Friday flow switched to net call buying/restructure demand.
The main regime pivot remains the October 17.5-18 forward zone.
summary.daily_note: Compared with 2026-09-24, short-vol flow aligned with price: spot VIX and Oct/Nov forwards compressed instead of absorbing supply through higher volatility.

leave_one_out.comment: The deep-ITM Oct28 put vertical dominates gross premium but contributes only about -$0.5M net transaction delta; directional short-vol read remains intact without it.
